Tests complex af-tags (superseded)

Source: R/af_tags.R
af_test_complex.Rd

This function is designed for testing af-tags that filter from one item to another by skipping items in between (under condition x). It tests for NA equality between test_var and target_var and additionally whether all variables in overfiltered_vars are NA. If any errors occur, it prints the problematic cases with specified extra variables if requested.

Usage

af_test_complex(
  data,
  test_var,
  target_var,
  overfiltered_vars,
  condition_var = NULL,
  operator = "equal",
  condition_value = NULL,
  empty_as_na = TRUE,
  print_filter_vars = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A neps field-data dataframe.

test_var

A string representing the variable where we want to test the af-tag.

target_var

A string representing the variable where the af-tag is pointing to.

overfiltered_vars

A string or character vector of variables that must be NA as part of the skipped items.

condition_var

A string representing a variable name to be used as a conditional variable.

operator

A string specifying the operator to be used for the condition. Acceptable operators include: "equal", "unequal", "greater", "smaller", "greaterequal", "smallerequal", and "inlist".

condition_value

A string or numeric value to be used as the conditional value.

empty_as_na

Logical, if TRUE empty strings ("") in character variables will be treated as NA. Default is TRUE.

print_filter_vars

Optional character vector of variable names to be included and prioritized in the printed output when errors occur. Useful for showing filtered or relevant variables clearly.

Value

Invisibly returns the tested rows (subsetted to the condition and to rows where test_var is not NA) if both tests pass. Otherwise prints the problematic rows and stops with an error.

Superseded

This function tests exit filters (af-tags) of older PVs. New PVs use entry filters (ef-tags), use ef_test() for those. The function is kept for PVs that still contain af-tags.

See also

Other superseded af-tag tests: af_test_simple()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# item a1 with --af: if (a1 = 2) goto a5: a2 to a4 must be NA, a5 must be asked
af_test_complex(mydata, test_var = "a1", target_var = "a5",
                overfiltered_vars = c("a2", "a3", "a4"),
                condition_var = "a1", operator = "equal", condition_value = 2)
} # }
